items.text: As soon as Andy got home, he buried his face in his pillow. <break time="0.8s" /> His body was tired, but his heart hurt more. <break time="0.8s" /> As captain of his schools basketball team, he had missed two free throws in the last minute, and his team lost to their rivals in the final. <break time="0.8s" /> If only I would stayed calm and made those shots, we would have won, he said to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> He could not even remember that he had scored more points than any other player in the game. <break time="0.8s" /> Andy, is something wrong, his father asked anxiously from outside his bedroom door, but he did not answer. <break time="0.8s" /> For a few days, Andy hardly spoke to anyone, blaming himself for losing the game and disappointing his teammates. <break time="0.8s" /> When Andys father learned why, he comforted Andy with encouraging words. <break time="0.8s" /> The next day, he suggested seeing the school counselor. <break time="0.8s" /> Andy was not convinced. <break time="0.8s" /> I just want to forget what happened. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, what is the point of talking to someone about it. <break time="0.8s" /> His father reassured him. <break time="0.8s" /> There might be something you can learn from sharing your feelings. <break time="0.8s" /> Opening up your heart to the counselor and listening to his advice will help. <break time="0.8s" /> After some thought, Andy agreed to meet Mister Johnson, the school counselor. <break time="0.8s" /> His warm welcome helped Andy slowly explain his emotions and the guilt that kept him from facing his teammates. <break time="0.8s" /> After Andy finished his story, Mister Johnson said gently, You seem to blame yourself because you do not want to disappoint your teammates. <break time="0.8s" /> That shows how much you care about them. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, he asked, If a teammate you cared about made the same mistake, would you harshly blame him. <break time="0.8s" /> Andy thought for a moment and realized that he would not. <break time="0.8s" /> Andy learned that sharing his feelings with someone could help him manage them and find comfort. <break time="0.8s" /> After thinking about the conversation with Mister Johnson, he could not wait to see his teammates. <break time="0.8s" /> When he joined team training again, everyone welcomed him back. <break time="0.8s" /> Andy said to his teammates, I am sorry, I was foolish to think you would hate me. <break time="0.8s" /> Of course we do not, said his teammate Charles. <break time="0.8s" /> We are a team, and we are lucky to have a captain who cares about his teammates as much as you do. <break time="0.8s" /> Charles added with a smile, Your performance was unbelievable, Nobody could stop you.
